description_en: Invokes this operation to query the statistics information of jobs in each status under a specified node
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定任务下各状态作业的统计信息
name: QueryJobStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The job status details returned if the invoke was successful. See the following parameter descriptions for details
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的作业状态详情，请参见以下参数说明

Cancelled.description_en: The total number of cancelled jobs under the task
Cancelled.description_zh: 对应任务下被取消的作业总数量

Failed.description_en: The total number of jobs that failed under the task
Failed.description_zh: 对应任务下执行失败的作业总数量

InProgress.description_en: The total number of jobs in progress under the task
InProgress.description_zh: 对应任务下执行中的作业总数量

Queued.description_en: The total number of jobs pending execution under the task
Queued.description_zh: 对应任务下待执行的作业总数量

Rejected.description_en: The total number of jobs rejected by devices under the task
Rejected.description_zh: 对应任务下被设备拒绝的作业总数量

Sent.description_en: The total number of jobs in the pushed status under the task
Sent.description_zh: 对应任务下处于已推送状态的作业总数量

Succeeded.description_en: The total number of jobs that succeeded under the task
Succeeded.description_zh: 对应任务下执行成功的作业总数量

TimeOut.description_en: The total number of jobs that timed out under the task
TimeOut.description_zh: 对应任务下执行超时的作业总数量

Total.description_en: The total number of jobs under the task
Total.description_zh: 对应任务下的作业总数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
